report: Endometrial adenocarcinoma plus pruritic annular/polycyclic rash and eosinophil-rich infiltrate without vasculitis indicates paraneoplastic eosinophilic dermatosis. Radiation dermatitis and drug/contact hypersensitivity are unlikely given morphology and no new medications/chemotherapy/contrast/travel. Paraneoplastic/autoimmune (node-8), specifically paraneoplastic eosinophilic dermatosis with endometrial adenocarcinoma (node-10), is supported. Missing direct immunofluorescence and autoimmune/paraneoplastic antibody tests limit confirmation, but the diagnosis is sufficiently refined.
answer: Eosinophilic, polymorphic, and pruritic eruption associated with radiotherapy (EPPER)
